lines.zh: 我四足走着，偶尔抬起前身
lines.en: I walk on four legs, sometimes rearing up
My long crest curves back

lines.zh: 我的头冠向后弯，吹得响。
lines.en: My crest curves back and sounds.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴摆着，保持平衡
lines.en: My tail swings for balance
I step into the shallows
I push through the ferns

lines.zh: 我低头看了看水里的倒影
lines.en: I look down at my reflection

lines.zh: 我的冠在灌木上刮了一下
lines.en: My crest scrapes a bush

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可步子很大
lines.en: I'm not fast, but my stride is long
I head for the forest's edge

lines.zh: 我把头抬得很高，看得远
lines.en: I hold my head high to see far
I change direction and walk on

lines.zh: 我踩在软土上，陷了一点
lines.en: I sink a little into the soft soil
I step over a fallen log
I stand with my crest into the wind

lines.zh: 我发出的低音在胸腔里
lines.en: A low note sits in my chest
The hollows of my crest hum.

lines.zh: 我在听林子深处的响动
lines.en: I'm listening to the deep wood
I let my tail hang
Sun spreads over my back
I breathe slowly
The young shoots here are just right
I lift a forefoot and set it down
Something calls far off
I don't answer that call

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰自己的肩
lines.en: I nudge my own shoulder with my snout
I hear that sound again
I stand still, crest unmoving

lines.zh: 你站在那里，我先听了听
lines.en: You stand there and I listen first

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，冠饰在后。
lines.en: I turn my head. The crest follows.

lines.zh: 你身上没有林子的味道
lines.en: You don't smell of the woods
I rear up, taller than you
You back off and I come down
I've no horns, but I'm heavy

lines.zh: 你手上的东西让我在意
lines.en: What's in your hand concerns me
We look at each other a while
I sound one low note
That note carries far
If you understand, step back
I don't want to fight here
I step back and my tail lashes
I call out and the note shakes
I rear and come down
I lower my head to the wound
I shake my head and my crest sways
I retreat a little in the water
I turn, dragging my tail
My breathing is heavy
I stand and stop retreating
I raise my crested head
Are those young shoots
I smell green grass
Hold it a little lower
My neck reaches far
I take it and back away
This tastes really good
Give me the rest if there is any
I'm in no hurry; I chew slowly
Keep your palm flatter
I'm done; you may go

lines.zh: 你撞上我的踝骨，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my ankle bone and bounce off.
My long tail catches you
I step back and the shallows splash
You squeeze past my flank
We bump and you bounce off
My crest knocks your helmet
The blow turns me a step aside
I find my footing in the water
That carried little force
I've cleared the way

lines.zh: 林子那头传来同样的低音
lines.en: The same low note comes from the trees
I answer with a longer one
We come together from two sides

lines.zh: 它的冠比我的弯得厉害
lines.en: Its crest curves more sharply than mine
Our heads touch
We walk into the shallows together

lines.zh: 我们同时发出声音，合成一个
lines.en: We call at once, and the notes merge
It lies down on the bank
I stand beside it

lines.zh: 这一片河岸以后有两个
lines.en: Two of us on this bank now
I take it up in my flat beak
It's not soft, and not edible
I spit it out to look
I toe it off to one side
It drops from my mouth
I pin it with a forefoot
This isn't a branch
I leave it on the bank
It's shiny; strange
I turn and walk off along the bank
You've raised something
I rear up

lines.zh: 我的低音在胸腔里攒起来
lines.en: The low note gathers in my chest
I rear up, my crest tilting back.
What I have carries weight
Don't stand by my tail
I come on, one foot after another
Water splashes under my feet
I've placed you by sound
Did you hear that note
I know this bank well
Retreating into the water won't help
I don't like being blocked
I'm coming through now

lines.zh: 我发出一声长长的低音
lines.en: I sound a long, low note
The note hits the trees and returns

lines.zh: 我的低音震得树叶发响。
lines.en: My low call makes the leaves rattle.
I bear down on you slowly
I turn side-on and fix you in view.
You go left and I turn
My steps muddy the water
I stop and call again
You may feel dizzy
A low note presses out of my crest.
The echoes here work for me

lines.zh: 我这顶长冠，能吹出低音。
lines.en: This long crest of mine can blow a low note.
I'm not rushing
One more note will do
What you hear is getting closer
I lash out with my tail
It lands on your side
I rear and stomp
The blow leaves a pit
I ram your chest with my crest.
My crest rakes your shoulder
I miss and water sprays
I step back and reset
The note leaves your steps unsteady
I ram again
I turn and hit with my shoulder
I shove you back into the water
That one was too hard
I slide half a step myself
The ferns on the bank stir
I step out from behind a tree
My crest rises above the ferns.
I call once toward the trees
My legs part the grass
The water's edge is good; I go there
My crest can blow a low note.
I lower my head and drink
This bank is strangely quiet
I lift my head and sight you
I walk slowly to the bank

lines.zh: 我的脚步在泥上留下深印
lines.en: My steps leave deep prints in the mud
The light at the forest's edge is good
I call once more
The note circles through the trees
I've chosen this place
I step onto the bank, stride by stride
The water is still moving

lines.zh: 火燎到我的冠，我猛甩头
lines.en: Fire catches my crest and I shake my head hard

lines.zh: 我从岸上滑下去，撞进水里
lines.en: I slide off the bank into the water
Water fills my nose and I rear my head up

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得撞在树上
lines.en: The blast drives me into a tree
An arrow sticks in the frill of my neck
That force makes my footing fail

lines.zh: 这一带的嫩枝都被吃光了
lines.en: The young shoots here are all gone

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我四腿弯曲
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and my legs bend

lines.zh: 脚下没有河岸，我踩不到地
lines.en: No bank below; my feet find nothing
